sql:
SELECT
  f.title,
  c.company_name,
  f.published_at
FROM fct_posting AS f
JOIN dim_company AS c
  ON f.company_key = c.company_key
WHERE
  f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE
ORDER BY
  f.published_at ASC
LIMIT 1
